stem: Which compound can form hydrogen bonds between its molecules in the pure liquid?

verdicts.working: Ethanol has an O–H bond and oxygen lone pairs, so its molecules can hydrogen-bond to each other. The other options lack an appropriate hydrogen-bond donor.

working:
$\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH}$ has an O–H bond, so its molecules can form intermolecular hydrogen bonds.

Independent check: Ethanol has an O–H bond and oxygen lone pairs, so its molecules can hydrogen-bond to each other. The other options lack an appropriate hydrogen-bond donor.
solution: Intermolecular hydrogen bonding requires hydrogen bonded to a highly electronegative atom such as O, N, or F. Ethanol contains an O–H bond, so its molecules form hydrogen bonds in the pure liquid.
